# Catalytic Magic Memory

> A deterministic reusable magic-state factory with a fixed noisy-input budget needs logarithmically growing stored magic and quantum memory as output infidelity vanishes. A matching CCZ construction follows from attributed batch-distillation and catalytic-conversion results.

## Reading routes

- **Overview:** [README](README.md) → [scientific route](science/README.md).
- **Full argument:** [model](science/model.md) → [converse](science/converse.md) → [construction](science/construction.md) → [resources](science/resources.md).
- **Study:** [30-milestone map](learning/MILESTONES.md) → [Watrous bridge](learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md) → the scientific pages linked by each milestone. The map has 13 background/preliminaries and 17 narrative/innovation milestones. Watrous is the sole educational anchor; the bridge translates conventions and develops worked examples.
- **Reproduction:** [verification guide](verification/README.md) → [run_all.py](verification/run_all.py) → [expected outputs](verification/expected.json). Run `python3 verification/run_all.py` from the root.

## Scientific distinctions to preserve

The source and its nonzero noise are fixed as output infidelity vanishes. Fresh source blocks are independent of the past, and their per-call budget stays fixed. Exact return concerns the complete catalyst marginal, including correlated control; outputs may remain correlated. Free classical storage is unrestricted but finite in each instance. A classical controller has a classical–quantum joint state, not merely a diagonal marginal.

The converse allows completely stabilizer-preserving channels and arbitrary mixed catalysts. It covers every fixed finite input budget and imposes no input–target resource ordering. Its free-input comparison does not require catalyst return on that comparison input. The finite-horizon return-error estimate gives no unlimited-reuse guarantee for a fixed nonzero disturbance.

The matching CCZ construction uses physical stabilizer operations, sufficiently clean fixed noise and a sufficient constant budget. It charges initialization without a perfect magic seed. Its large constants establish logical-memory scaling; physical fault-tolerant qubits, gate counts and runtime need additional implementation assumptions. Return only upon heralded success is outside the stated model.

Use the scientific pages for exact statements and proofs. Preserve their quantifiers, error conventions and attribution when editing summaries. Run the documented checks after substantive changes, and distinguish their finite scope from the analytical theorems. [Provenance](references/PROVENANCE.md) provides durable historical sources and restoration records.
